SELECT order_item.* FROM scc_sou_order_item order_item LEFT JOIN scc_sou_project project on order_item.PROJECT_ID = project.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sou_inq_project inq_project on inq_project.PROJECT_ID = order_item.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sou_item sou_item on order_item.SOU_ITEM_ID = sou_item.SOU_ITEM_ID left join scc_sou_inq_item inq_item on order_item.SOU_ITEM_ID=inq_item.SOU_ITEM_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND project.SOU_TYPE = 'inq' AND order_item.ORDER_STATUS IN ('SUBMISSION', 'CANCEL')
and inq_item.EXT_BRAND like concat('%', concat(#{extBrand}, '%'))
AND order_item.VENDOR_ID = #{vendorId}
AND exists ( SELECT * from scc_sou_vendor vendor WHERE vendor.PROJECT_ID = order_item.PROJECT_ID AND vendor.VENDOR_ID = order_item.VENDOR_ID AND vendor.VENDOR_NAME LIKE concat('%', concat(#{vendorName}, '%')) )
AND project.SOU_NO like concat('%', concat(#{souNo}, '%'))
AND sou_item.ITEM_CODE like concat('%', concat(#{itemCode}, '%'))
AND sou_item.ITEM_DESC like concat('%', concat(#{itemDesc}, '%'))
AND ( project.CURRENT_ROUND > order_item.ROUND OR inq_project.EXT_PROJECT_STATUS IN ('EVALUATING', 'PRICE_END') )
order by project.SOU_NO desc, sou_item.SORT_INDEX asc

SELECT count( oi.SOU_ITEM_ID ) ORDER_COUNT, oi.SOU_ITEM_ID, oi.ROUND FROM scc_sou_order_item oi WHERE (oi.SOU_ITEM_ID, oi.ROUND) IN
(#{item.souItemId}, #{item.round})
AND oi.ORDER_STATUS = 'SUBMISSION' GROUP BY oi.SOU_ITEM_ID, oi.ROUND
